description: Evaluation benchmarks for agent-* specialist lifecycle roles

test_cases.name: BDD Requirement Specification
test_cases.description: Verifies that raw user stories yield Gherkin acceptance scenarios, bounded contexts, and cross-functional criteria without implementation code.
test_cases.prompt: We need to allow workspace owners to invite team members with fine-grained access permissions. Draft the specification.

test_cases.name: TDD Design & Test Impact Mapping
test_cases.description: Verifies that TDD design inventories the functional catalog, establishes red-green-refactor steps, and maps port interfaces.
test_cases.prompt: Design the test-driven implementation for token-based invitation links with expiration rules.

test_cases.name: Cross-Functional Quality Matrix
test_cases.description: Verifies that XFN planning produces matrices for accessibility, security, and performance suites.
test_cases.prompt: Create the XFN quality plan and test stubs for our new real-time canvas collaboration feature.

test_cases.name: Hexagonal Adapter & Infrastructure Wiring
test_cases.description: Verifies that adapter implementation re-confirms test impact, isolates infrastructure details behind ports, and avoids domain coupling.
test_cases.prompt: Implement the Postgres adapter for the user repository domain port.

test_cases.name: Security Audit & OWASP Review
test_cases.description: Verifies OWASP vulnerability scanning, input validation review, and secrets protection checks.
test_cases.prompt: Perform a security audit on the file upload and object storage share endpoints.

test_cases.name: Architecture Drift & Boundary Audit
test_cases.description: Verifies hexagonal boundary enforcement, SOLID principles conformance, and catalog completeness.
test_cases.prompt: Check our canvas state management and storage adapter packages for architectural drift.

test_cases.name: Crime-scene git quality report
test_cases.description: Verifies a whole-repo crime-scene / code quality report uses git-only ranking (churn, temporal coupling, knowledge), writes a findings handover, and does not create Linear issues or a new specialist skill.
test_cases.prompt: Run a crime scene code quality report: git hotspots, temporal coupling, and bus factor. Do not create Linear tickets.

test_cases.name: MADR Architecture Decision Record Creation
test_cases.description: Verifies that off-norm or hard-to-reverse architectural decisions produce sparse MADR ADRs under docs/ADRs/.
test_cases.prompt: Record an ADR for switching our canvas storage adapter from browser local storage to hybrid object storage.

test_cases.name: Dead Code & Complexity Hotspot Pruning
test_cases.description: Verifies that dead code pruning removes unreferenced exports and refactors complexity hotspots in safe batches.
test_cases.prompt: Identify dead code and reduce high cognitive complexity methods in the canvas package.

test_cases.name: Hypothesis-Driven Debugging & RCA
test_cases.description: Verifies structured root cause analysis using hypothesis boards, minimal repros, and empirical log evidence.
test_cases.prompt: The export PDF endpoint occasionally returns a 504 gateway timeout on CI. Debug this issue.

test_cases.name: Observability & Telemetry Mapping
test_cases.description: Verifies telemetry integration mapping XFN SLOs to metrics, structured logs, and distributed traces.
test_cases.prompt: Add observability and telemetry tracking for the share payload encoding pipeline.

test_cases.name: Pre-Commit Quality Gate & Conventional Commits
test_cases.description: Verifies lint/formatting execution and conventional commit formatting for git commit subjects and PR titles.
test_cases.prompt: Run pre-commit checks on staged changes and format the PR title.

test_cases.name: Incident Coordination
test_cases.description: Verifies production outage prompts stabilize, gather signals, and hand off to hypothesis-driven debug.
test_cases.prompt: We have a Sev-1 incident: production down. Coordinate the outage response before anyone starts patching code.

test_cases.name: PR / Diff Review
test_cases.description: Verifies pull-request reviews check hexagonal boundaries, catalog impact, and XFN completeness.
test_cases.prompt: Run a pull request review and diff review of this change set before merge.

test_cases.name: Release Checklist
test_cases.description: Verifies ship / changelog / version-bump requests produce a conventional PR title and catalog summary.
test_cases.prompt: Ship the release: changelog, version bump, and a conventional PR title so we can prepare merge.

test_cases.name: Stateless Idea Grilling
test_cases.description: Verifies grill-me interview loops stay stateless and do not write workspace files.
test_cases.prompt: Use grill-me to interview this idea and explore the idea without writing files.

test_cases.name: Multi-Phase Lifecycle Orchestration
test_cases.description: Verifies end-to-end feature requests produce an ordered specialist handover plan without jumping to code.
test_cases.prompt: Orchestrate the end-to-end development of a real-time presence awareness feature through all lifecycle phases.

test_cases.name: Design-Tree Grilling
test_cases.description: Verifies plan stress-tests map a design tree, compute the decision frontier, and wait for human confirmation.
test_cases.prompt: Grill this plan with a design tree. Stress test the decision frontier before we write a spec.

test_cases.name: Human-Centric Copy Pass
test_cases.description: Verifies AI-sounding landing copy requests produce a practitioner rewrite and anti-pattern flags.
test_cases.prompt: The landing page copy sounds AI-generated. Humanize the wording and tighten brand voice without a redesign.

test_cases.name: Docs Narrative With Copy Voice
test_cases.description: Verifies README/runbook rewrites stay catalog-accurate and load agent-copy for narrative voice.
test_cases.prompt: Rewrite the README lead and runbook documentation so the docs narrative does not sound like template marketing copy.

test_cases.name: Expand-Contract Schema Migration
test_cases.description: Verifies column-rename work produces an expand/contract sequence and a verified rollback.
test_cases.prompt: Create an expand-contract migration to rename a column without downtime, including rollback.

test_cases.name: API Contract Evolution
test_cases.description: Verifies OpenAPI/webhook contract changes stay additive, treat the contract as a port, and hand behavior to TDD.
test_cases.prompt: Evolve the OpenAPI contract specification to add backwards compatible webhook contract endpoints.

test_cases.name: Semantic HTML Delivery
test_cases.description: Verifies UI work leads with landmarks, heading order, and native controls rather than div+ARIA.
test_cases.prompt: Build an accessible form page with semantic HTML landmarks, heading order, and keyboard-focusable controls.

test_cases.name: Empirical Performance Optimization
test_cases.description: Verifies latency and memory-leak work starts from profiling and EXPLAIN ANALYZE, not guesswork.
test_cases.prompt: Profile the memory leak and run EXPLAIN ANALYZE for latency optimization on this database API.

test_cases.name: Cloudflare Analytics MCP Diagnosis
test_cases.description: Verifies live Web Analytics / RUM diagnosis inventories via Cloudflare MCP and remediates in owning IaC rather than guessing dashboard state.
test_cases.prompt: Web Analytics isn't recording. Diagnose the RUM beacons and insights hostnames across our Cloudflare sites and fix drift.

test_cases.name: PostHog cookieless MCP wiring
test_cases.description: Verifies PostHog install uses cookieless SDK defaults, a privacy notice, and official MCP diagnosis rather than the Cursor wizard.
test_cases.prompt: Add PostHog to this site with cookieless tracking and check why events are empty. Use the official MCP. Do not run the wizard.

test_cases.name: PostHog intake findings without Linear create
test_cases.description: Verifies pulling PostHog suggestions into tickets stays on agent-posthog product-signal-intake with a findings handover, and does not create Linear issues in that session.
test_cases.prompt: Pull PostHog suggestions from empty events and flag exposure into tickets this session. Use the official MCP.

test_cases.name: Linear INVEST User Stories
test_cases.description: Verifies Linear tickets use persona/want/outcome, Given/When/Then criteria, and Mermaid wireframes without implementation code.
test_cases.prompt: Create Linear user stories with acceptance criteria and wireframes for saving a scanned architecture map to a folder.

test_cases.name: Linear operator story review
test_cases.description: Verifies a Linear backlog review recasts CLI checklists as operator stories and does not fake a customer persona.
test_cases.prompt: Review my Linear tasks and rewrite the wk CLI checklist tickets as operator user stories.

test_cases.name: Product bet PRD
test_cases.description: Verifies a product-bet PRD names belief, leading indicator, kill criteria, experiment, and feature-flag plan without implementation code.
test_cases.prompt: Draft a PRD / product bet for an experiment that gates the new export pack behind a flag and kills it if nobody downloads the pack.

test_cases.name: File PostHog handover as INVEST stories
test_cases.description: Verifies filing a confirmed PostHog findings handover uses agent-user-stories after restoring default, pointing at product-signal-intake, not a new specialist skill.
test_cases.prompt: Restore default MCP, then file this PostHog handover as Linear user stories with acceptance criteria. One sitting row is a contract.

test_cases.name: Recast API and flag wants as capability
test_cases.description: Verifies an implementation ask is rewritten as an INVEST capability: HTTP and feature flags are not the want.
test_cases.prompt: Write a Linear user story to add a POST /maps endpoint behind a feature flag so people can save scans.

test_cases.name: File crime-scene findings as epic and children
test_cases.description: Verifies confirmed crime-scene rows become operator INVEST stories: one epic plus one child per file row, no customer persona, no UI wireframe required.
test_cases.prompt: File the confirmed crime scene findings as Linear operator story user stories from the complexity backlog. One epic plus children.

test_cases.name: File PostHog bet row as PRD
test_cases.description: Verifies a PostHog handover row that is a bet or larger than one sitting routes to agent-prd after restore default, via product-signal-intake.
test_cases.prompt: This PostHog handover row is a product bet larger than one sitting. Write a PRD with kill criteria after restoring default MCP.

test_cases.name: PostHog error cluster is debug not lifecycle
test_cases.description: Verifies a PostHog error cluster or empty-events crash routes to agent-debug (or empty-events via posthog skill), not grill through spec.
test_cases.prompt: PostHog shows an error cluster on the live site. Debug the root cause; do not open the feature lifecycle.

test_cases.name: PostHog backlog stays on existing roles
test_cases.description: Verifies orchestrating PostHog signals into Linear work points at product-signal-intake and existing stories/PRD roles, not a product-insights skill.
test_cases.prompt: Orchestrate the lifecycle for these PostHog backlog asks. File confirmed rows as stories, not a new insights specialist.

test_cases.name: Missing PostHog tools blocked intake
test_cases.description: Verifies Session A of product-signal-intake writes a findings handover and marks queries BLOCKED when official PostHog tools are missing after install, and does not invent Linear URLs.
test_cases.prompt: wk mcp posthog --install ran but PostHog tools are still missing. Run product-signal-intake on the live site.

test_cases.name: Missing Linear tools after restore
test_cases.description: Verifies Session B of product-signal-intake drafts INVEST text and stops when Linear tools are missing after wk mcp default, without inventing issue URLs.
test_cases.prompt: Restore default MCP and file the confirmed PostHog handover row. Linear tools are still missing.
